note: Real-device testbed — LANDSCAPE (owner landscape directive, 2 Aug). SAUDA is a landscape-only game (see R0 / DECISIONS), so every capture/measure/profile run drives these landscape profiles: the same four real Android devices as the PHONE-1 portrait set, ROTATED — width and height swapped — plus a reduced-motion variant. Widths/heights are CSS px (the layout viewport, long edge horizontal); dpr is the real deviceScaleFactor; reducedMotion drives Playwright's reducedMotion + the app's prefers-reduced-motion. The TS wrapper (deviceProfiles.ts) and the Node capture scripts both read THIS file, so a profile is edited in one place. The tightest budget is now the SHORT edge (360px height): legacy-740x360 is the default single-still smoke subject.
